label: Pie / donut chart
desc: Pie or donut chart whose segments pull out on hover or focus, with a centre label, legend and optional leader-line labels.
use: dashboard revenue or traffic share, landing-page stats, publishing list breakdowns

label: Ring chart
desc: Concentric progress rings, one per category, with a centre total that animate in once.
use: dashboard usage by category, storage or quota overview, connect page limits

label: Radar chart
desc: Spider chart with up to three series polygons, grid rings and focusable vertices with tooltips.
use: comparison pages, skill or product profiles, dashboard scorecards

label: Funnel chart
desc: Conversion funnel of trapezoid stages with step percentages and drop-off between stages.
use: dashboard conversion analytics, sign-up flow reports, landing-page proof

label: Gauge chart
desc: Semicircle meter with low/ok/high colour bands, animated needle, target tick and a big readout.
use: dashboard health or capacity indicators, uptime and quota readouts

label: Heatmap chart
desc: Calendar or matrix heatmap on a sequential brand-tint scale with legend, tooltip and arrow-key grid navigation.
use: dashboard activity calendar, busiest hours matrix, publishing cadence

label: Sankey flow chart
desc: Flow diagram with proportional link widths between node columns; hovering or focusing a node highlights its flows.
use: dashboard traffic or funds flow, onboarding paths, order pipelines

label: US tile map
desc: Tile-grid cartogram of the US states coloured by value, with legend, tooltips and keyboard grid navigation.
use: dashboard regional breakdowns, store or customer locator summaries
